boss_D.en: We want key-handover photos, singles aren't the target. Redo.

ask.zh: 育嬰留停可以按日請了。趕快作圖！
ask.en: Unpaid parental leave can now be taken by the day.

ask.zh: 這張妳自己裁：拍請假的佩珊，還是留下來的妳？
ask.en: You crop this one: Penny taking leave, or you staying behind?

group.en: Sorry, taking one day of unpaid parental leave tomorrow for my kid's vaccination

group.zh: 顏座，我的案子先放妳那🙏
group.en: Boss Vivian, please hold my case 🙏

group.zh: 真好，我當年只能一次請完
group.en: Nice, I had to take all my parental leave at once

group.zh: 老顏又要加班了吧
group.en: Vivian's on overtime again huh

group.zh: 老顏妳也要請假啊
group.en: Vivian you should take leave too

1.zh: 組長拿那張反問我，說不用抱歉，那案子要叫誰扛責任
1.en: My team lead threw that poster back at me: no need to apologize, sure, but then who takes responsibility for the case?

1.zh: 一天的育嬰留停被記在考績上了啦，真的不好意思
1.en: That one day of unpaid parental leave got marked on my performance review, really sorry

1.zh: 老顏，我的案子先放在妳的桌上🙏
1.en: Vivian, I’m leaving my case on your desk for now 🙏

self.zh: 同學都留在畫面裡，妳的生活被裁掉了
self.en: Everyone stayed in the picture. Your life got cropped.

gone.zh: 宣傳照張張漂亮，天燈少了好幾盞
gone.en: Every poster looked great. Several lanterns never went up.

mix.en: No one was spared, not even you.

阿芳: 升主任了。小芋頭下午有人接，不是我。
Made director. Someone picks up Little Taro afternoons, not me.
回事務所了，主任沒升。小芋頭會自己走回家了。
Back at the office, no promotion. Little Taro walks home alone now.
家豪: 小太陽四十八個，招牌還亮著。
Little Sun has 48 kids, sign still shining.
小太陽剩三十個。招牌我自己補漆。
Little Sun down to 30. I repaint the sign myself.
宜君: 薪水三萬二。暑假帶媽看富士山，假單只准三天啦。
32,000. Taking Mom to Okinawa this summer, only got 3 days off.
三萬了。富士山，明年一定排進行程啦。
志豪: 還沒存到八十萬，下個月先求婚。戒指拿出抽屜了。
Haven't saved 800k yet, proposing next month. Ring's out of the drawer.
還在存。小雯說她不急，我急。
Still saving. Wendy says she's not rushed, I am.
佩珊: 孩子會叫媽媽了。請假單還是先寫不好意思。
Baby says mama now. Still start my leave note with sorry.
請假還是會道歉。孩子很好。
Still apologize for leave. Kid's doing good.

阿芳: 小芋頭明年抽到公幼。我回事務所上班，三十五歲升主任。
Little Taro wins the lottery for a cheap public preschool next year. I go back to the firm and make manager by 35.
家豪: 小太陽幼兒園招生滿 60 個。爸寫的招牌要撐過第 30 年。
“Little Sun” fills all 60 places. Dad’s hand-painted sign makes it to year 30.
宜君: 月薪到 30,000。暑假帶我媽去富士山，機票我都先買好了啦。
Pay goes to 30K a month. Taking Mom to Okinawa this summer, tickets already booked.
志豪: 九點前下班。存到 80 萬頭期款，到時跟小雯求婚。
Off work before 9. Save an 800k down payment, then I can finally propose to Wendy.
佩珊: 三十歲前生第一個。請假不用跟任何人道歉。
First baby before 30. Taking leave without apologizing to anyone.
